about.title: About DoctorAibolit
about.missionBody: DoctorAibolit provides accessible, private health guidance to help people understand their symptoms and make informed decisions about their health.
about.howBody: Our AI analyzes your symptoms and health questions to provide general educational information and guidance. We use advanced AI technology trained on medical literature to offer helpful, accurate information.
about.offer1: Free Support: Start with 5 free messages to explore our service.
about.offer2: Privacy First: Your conversations are private and not stored long-term.
about.offer3: No Login Required: Start chatting immediately without creating an account.
about.offer4: 24/7 Availability: Get health guidance whenever you need it.
about.offer5: AI-Powered: Advanced AI technology for accurate health information.
about.noticeBody: DoctorAibolit is not a medical service and cannot replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider for medical concerns.
about.commitmentBody: We are committed to providing helpful, accurate health information while maintaining the highest standards of privacy and user safety.
about.contactBody: Have questions or feedback? Visit our Contact page to get in touch with our team.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summaryBody: We collect minimal information to provide our service. We do not require account creation or personal identification.
privacy.collect1: Anonymous session data to maintain your conversation
privacy.collect2: Email address if you purchase credits (for receipt and credit restoration)
privacy.collect3: General usage analytics to improve the service
privacy.collect4: Technical data such as browser type and approximate location
privacy.use1: To provide and improve our health guidance service
privacy.use2: To process payments and restore purchased credits
privacy.use3: To ensure the security and proper functioning of the service
privacy.use4: We do not sell your personal information to third parties
privacy.rights1: You may request deletion of any personal data we hold
privacy.rights2: You may opt out of analytics by adjusting your browser settings
privacy.rights3: Contact us via the Contact page for any privacy-related requests

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.noticeBody: DoctorAibolit is NOT a medical service. It provides general educational health information only.
disclaimer.infoBody: The information provided by DoctorAibolit is for general educational purposes only and is not intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of your physician or other qualified health provider.
disclaimer.emergencyBody: If you are experiencing a medical emergency, contact:
disclaimer.emergency1: Emergency Services: 911 (US) or your local emergency number
disclaimer.emergency3: Crisis Text Line: Text HOME to 741741
disclaimer.limitsBody: AI-generated health information may not be accurate, complete, or applicable to your specific situation. The AI does not have access to your medical history and cannot perform physical examinations.
disclaimer.liabilityBody: DoctorAibolit and its operators shall not be liable for any damages arising from the use or reliance on information provided by this service.
